title: Beta
summary: Beta is the codename of an elite Suit working for the Organization. He always works with his partner, Alpha, and together they served as the personal bodyguards of the Professor.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Beta and Alpha travelled to Ethiopia with the Professor and Rassimov. [The Golden Asp] He later fought the Huntik team in King Solomon's mines but was forced to retreat when Lok Lambert invoked the Legendary Titan of Spirit, Tao. [To Be Together]

He was later involved in the attack on Dante Vale's house and fought with the Huntik team. [The Secret of Two Generations] When the Huntik team raided the Professor's castle, he invoked his Terrapede Titan, but was scared off by a freshly woken Cherit. [The Divine Comedy]

When the Huntik team broke into Organization Central, this Suit fought and was defeated by Lok Lambert. [Doorway to Huntik]

When Grier led the Huntik team to the Professor's Castle, Hoffman sent him and Alpha to fight Dante and Grier. After a long battle, they were defeated by Grier. [An Ally from the Organization]

full_text:
Beta is the codename of an elite Suit working for the Organization. He always works with his partner, Alpha, and together they served as the personal bodyguards of the Professor.

History

Beta and Alpha travelled to Ethiopia with the Professor and Rassimov. [The Golden Asp] He later fought the Huntik team in King Solomon's mines but was forced to retreat when Lok Lambert invoked the Legendary Titan of Spirit, Tao. [To Be Together]

He was later involved in the attack on Dante Vale's house and fought with the Huntik team. [The Secret of Two Generations] When the Huntik team raided the Professor's castle, he invoked his Terrapede Titan, but was scared off by a freshly woken Cherit. [The Divine Comedy]

When the Huntik team broke into Organization Central, this Suit fought and was defeated by Lok Lambert. [Doorway to Huntik]

When Grier led the Huntik team to the Professor's Castle, Hoffman sent him and Alpha to fight Dante and Grier. After a long battle, they were defeated by Grier. [An Ally from the Organization]

Abilities

Along with his partner, Alpha, Beta is one of the most highly-skilled Suits in the Organization, and is highly trained in the martial arts, able to hold his own against Dante Vale. He was armed with a variety Organization spells and Titans.

Spells Utilized

• Augerfrost
• Boltflare
• Fireswarm
• Poisonfang
• Raypulse

Bonded Titans

Enforcer — A standard issue Organization Titan used for aerial attacks.

Terrapede — A powerful centipede creature awarded to the most promising Organization agents.

Gallery

Image caption: Suit Beta

Image caption: Suits Alpha and Beta

Trivia

• Although they were never named on screen, Alpha and Beta's names were revealed in the Netflix subtitles of Episode 46, "An Ally from the Organization" when using their powers against Dante and Grier.
